mapper.select: SELECT m1.sys_id AS "sysId", m1.brd_id AS "brdId", m1.brd_nm AS "brdNm", m1.brd_expl AS "brdExpl", m1.brd_type AS "brdType", m2.user_write_yn AS "userWriteYn", m2.user_reply_yn AS "userReplyYn", m2.atch_file_yn AS "atchFileYn", m2.secret_use_yn AS "secretUseYn", m2.rereply_yn AS "rereplyYn", m2.rereply_depth AS "rereplyDepth", m2.cmt_atch_file_yn AS "cmtAtchFileYn", m1.use_yn AS "useYn", m1.del_yn AS "delYn" FROM TN_BRD_M001 m1 LEFT JOIN TN_BRD_M002 m2 ON m1.sys_id = m2.sys_id AND m1.brd_id = m2.brd_id WHERE m1.sys_id = #{sysId} AND m1.brd_id = #{brdId}

WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND brd_id = #{brdId} AND del_yn = 'N'
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND wrtr_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))

SELECT p.idx AS "idx", p.post_no AS "postNo", p.title AS "title", p.wrtr_nm AS "wrtrNm", p.inq_cnt AS "inqCnt", p.frst_reg_dt AS "frstRegDt", p.del_yn AS "delYn", p.ntc_yn AS "ntcYn", p.highlight_yn AS "highlightYn", p.atch_file_grp_id AS "atchFileGrpId", p.content AS "content", p.secret_yn AS "secretYn", p.secret_pwd AS "secretPwd", (SELECT file_sn FROM TN_COM_F001 f WHERE f.sys_id = p.sys_id AND f.file_grp_id = p.atch_file_grp_id AND f.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY file_sn ASC LIMIT 1) AS thumb_sn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TN_BRD_C001 c WHERE c.sys_id = p.sys_id AND c.post_idx = p.idx AND c.del_yn = 'N') AS "cmtCnt" FROM TN_BRD_M003 p
ORDER BY p.ntc_yn DESC, p.idx DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT idx AS "idx", post_no AS "postNo", title AS "title", content AS "content", wrtr_nm AS "wrtrNm", inq_cnt AS "inqCnt", frst_reg_dt AS "frstRegDt", del_yn AS "delYn", ntc_yn AS "ntcYn", highlight_yn AS "highlightYn", secret_yn AS "secretYn", secret_pwd AS "secretPwd", atch_file_grp_id AS "atchFileGrpId", brd_id AS "brdId", rls_start_dt AS "rlsStartDt", rls_end_dt AS "rlsEndDt" FROM TN_BRD_M003 WHERE sys_id = #{sysId} AND idx = #{idx} AND del_yn = 'N'
